item.title: Maca
item.description:
What it is: Maca is a Peruvian root vegetable nutrient-dense superfood containing amino acids, minerals, and compounds that support sexual function, fertility, and hormonal balance. Used traditionally for centuries, modern research validates its benefits for sexual performance and reproductive health.

Benefits

Sexual Function & Performance

  • Improves sexual desire and arousal
  • Supports erectile function and hardness
  • Enhances sexual satisfaction
  • Supports ejaculatory function
  • Improves female sexual function too

Fertility Support

  • May improve semen quality and motility
  • Supports reproductive health
  • Complements fertility optimization
  • May improve sperm count
  • Particularly valuable for male fertility

Hormonal Balance

  • Supports healthy hormone levels
  • May improve mood and emotional balance
  • Energy and stamina support
  • Overall vitality enhancement

Nutrient Density

  • Rich in amino acids and minerals
  • Contains vitamins and bioactive compounds
  • Whole food nutrient matrix
  • Complements healthy diet

Energy & Stamina

  • May improve energy and endurance
  • Supports physical performance
  • Athletic resilience support
  • Complements training

Dosage

Sexual function support: 1,500-2,000 mg daily Enhanced fertility: 2,000-2,500 mg daily Full spectrum: 2,500-3,000 mg daily Timing: With meals Duration: 2-4 weeks for initial effects; 8+ weeks for full benefits

item.title: Tongkat Ali
item.description:
What it is: Tongkat Ali is a traditional Malaysian herbal containing quassinoids and other compounds that support testosterone production, sexual function, and athletic performance. Modern research validates its testosterone-boosting properties and muscle-building support.

Benefits

Testosterone Support

  • May significantly support healthy testosterone levels
  • Particularly effective when baseline is low
  • Supports male vitality and confidence
  • Athletic performance improvement
  • Results documented in clinical research

Sexual Function & Libido

  • Improves sexual desire and arousal
  • Supports erectile function
  • Enhances sexual satisfaction
  • Improves sexual performance
  • Female sexual function support too

Athletic Performance

  • May improve muscle gains from training
  • Supports strength and power output
  • Enhances workout performance
  • Faster recovery post-exercise
  • Particularly valuable for athletes

Overall Vitality & Energy

  • May improve energy and mood
  • Supports confidence and motivation
  • Complements healthy lifestyle
  • Athletic resilience support

Dosage

Testosterone support: 300-400 mg daily Enhanced: 400-600 mg daily Full spectrum: 600-1,000 mg daily Timing: With meals Duration: 2-4 weeks for initial effects; 8+ weeks for full testosterone optimization
